description: This file contains a class `ReminderTests_Cosmos_Standalone` which implements unit tests for the Orleans Reminder system using Cosmos DB as backend. It includes test methods for insertion rate benchmarking, inserting and reading reminder rows, and utility functions for creating new reminder entries and retrieving all rows.
